forms.title: Moldova eVisa — application (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and European Integration)
forms.stoppedAt: The registration form was closed on 2026-10-07 by the portal's daily application limit; it asks for name, nationality and email in any case. Later steps named from the portal's Visa Application Guide

steps.name: Start Your Visa Application (registration)
notices: Dear applicants, the daily limit for visa applications for the Republic of Moldova has been reached for today. Please return after 00:00 UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) to submit your application.
Complete the initial registration form by providing: First name and last name; Nationality; Valid e-mail address
Important: Keep your Visa Reference Number in a safe place, as it will be required to access and continue your application.

steps.name: Complete Your Visa Application
notices: Upload the required supporting documents, which may include: Passport copy; Recent photograph; Travel itinerary; Accommodation details; Invitation letter (if applicable); Other documents requested for the selected visa category.

The application must be completed within the timeframe specified in the confirmation e-mail. Applications that remain incomplete after the deadline will be automatically deleted from the e-Visa system and cannot be restored.

steps.name: Receive the Decision
notices: Print or save the electronic visa and present it together with your passport when entering the Republic of Moldova.
